title: Palace defends Marcos as survey shows Duterte leading trust ratings

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. listens to the public’s concerns and needs when planning and implementing government programs, Palace Press Officer Claire Castro said Thursday Castro’s statement came after Pulse Asia Research’s September 2026 Ulat ng Bayan trust rating survey showed that 49 percent of respondents disapproved of Marcos’ performance, while 48 percent said they distrusted him.
